topic: Taint of a session that read across spaces
detail: SP-029's summary says the operator's explicit cross-space reads taint that session, but no acceptance item covers it and today no session reads across spaces except while memory filtering is switched off (SP-070, SP-025.1.a4); only Orch.app reads every space, and it has no session records. Proposed: when a session receives results from a space it may not read (filtering off), mark its pin tainted so its later records, summaries and client notes go to quarantine for the operator to retag. Needs a decision and probably a pin column (migration).
